captions.detailed: A compact travel camcorder featuring a matte black finish with a slim rectangular main body. A prominent cylindrical lens barrel is mounted on the front, complete with a dark blue glass lens element. On the side, a rectangular flip screen with rounded corners is attached by a vertical hinge. Additionally, a small, dark rectangular media-card hatch is located near the bottom side of the main body.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a travel camcorder with a slim rectangular body, a front-facing cylindrical lens barrel, and a side-mounted rectangular flip screen. The model should include a continuous rotation joint for the lens focus ring, a revolute joint for the side-hinged flip screen, and another revolute joint on the side of the body for a small media-card hatch.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a base 'body' part made from a main box with rounded edges and top-mounted box details. It defines three additional parts: a 'lens' composed of concentric cylinders (including a glass element), a 'screen' made of a flat rounded box, and a 'hatch' represented by a small flat box. It then links these parts to the base body using three joints: a continuous joint for the lens rotation, a revolute joint with limits on a vertical axis for the screen, and a revolute joint on a horizontal axis for the media-card hatch.
